newsitem.title: USA: Cardinal Health added to S&P 500 Index.
newsitem.headline: Cardinal Health added to S&P 500 Index.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said Thursday it will replace Conrail Inc in the S&P 500 Index with Cardinal Health Inc, a wholesale distributor of pharmaceuticals, medical and surgical supplies headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, after the close of trading Friday, May 23.

Cardinal Health, a component of the S&P MidCap 400 Index, will be replaced on the MidCap 400 by United States Filter Corp, a maker of industrial, commercial, and municipal water treatment systems headquartered in Palm Desert, California.
United States Filter, which is now a component of the S&P SmallCap 600 Index, will be replaced in the SmallCap 600 by Delta and Pine Land Co, S&P said.
Delta and Pine Land is the nation's largest commercial breeder, producer, and marketer of cotton planting seed and is headquartered in Scott, Mississippi.
Conrail is being acquired Norfolk Southern Corp and CSX Corp in a joint cash tender offer.
